payload.description_html: Part of the holotype of Dynamoterror dynastes McDonald et al. 2018 (UMNH VP 28348): Photographs and 3-D models of right (A, B) and left (C, D) frontals in rostral view. Abbreviations: bnp, base of nasal process; cnc, caudal extent of nasal cavity; plp, prefrontolacrimal process; pnp, prefrontonasal process; rpos, rostral part of postorbital suture; vls, ventrolateral part of lacrimal suture. Scale bars equal five cm.
